# Page owner types

Only entities whose entity_type is one of ('component', 'api', 'feature', 'business_rule', 'risk') are treated as page owners and are listed/linked as pages in the generated wiki.

Normalize which kinds of knowledge entities own wiki pages so that the emitter consistently generates and links owner pages.
